description: This file is a code-behind class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page 'EditExam.aspx'. It contains event handlers for button click events that transfer the user to different pages within the online exam system.

classes.name: EditExam
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind for the ASP.NET page 'EditExam.aspx', handling navigation via button clicks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the 'AdminPanel.aspx' page when the 'Home' button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the 'AdminQueue.aspx' page when the 'Profile' button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the 'AdminLeaderboard.aspx' page when the 'Leaderboard' button is clicked.

methods.name: eTheoryB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the 'EditTheory.aspx' page when the 'Edit Theory' button is clicked.

methods.name: eMcqB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the 'EditMCQ.aspx' page when the 'Edit MCQ' button is clicked.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers the user to the 'LoginPage.aspx' page when the 'Logout' button is clicked.
